title: Quick Poached Thai Ground Poppy Seeds Noodles
description: A funky and juicy Thai street food dish featuring ground poppy seeds, this recipe is a quick fix for a delicious meal, friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences. It combines the simplicity of poached noodles with the unique flavor of ground poppy seeds.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a blender or food processor, grind the poppy seeds into a fine powder.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground poppy seeds, soy sauce, lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss everything together.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
Poach the noodles briefly in the skillet if a softer texture is preferred.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
